headline: St. Thomas Aquinas end the season unbeaten by any member
dek: St. Thomas Aquinas closed the season by beating D'Youville, the side that had held them to a draw in October. Their four defeats all came against programmes from outside the conference, and only D'Youville and Molloy took a point off them.
displaced_by: St. Thomas Aquinas beat D'Youville in the season's last match, so the standing dek's 'D'Youville come next' is no longer true.
